'''GamePlayers Network''' (gameplayersnetwork.com) was a fan-run gaming site that, in Warren Holland's 25 January 2002 Players' Committee announcement, offered web-team help getting information to decipher.com, tools for email / boards / chat, and prize-support shipping for sanctioned SWCCG, Young Jedi, and Jedi Knights tournaments after 30 April 2002.

The [[Players Committee]] later listed GPN with [[DeckTech]] among the sites the PC forums overtook as the main community hub.
